summary: Flex LNG Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited financial results for Q1 2026, along with a business update. The filing discloses a quarterly dividend of $0.75 per share, new time charter contracts for vessels, and commentary on market conditions, including the impact of geopolitical events on LNG spot rates. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, activist campaign, strategic review, rights offering, or deal termination is announced. The filing is a routine earnings release and operational update, not a special-situation event.
